info.title: MadregotConnect API — public and member routes
info.description: Generated by scripts/gen-openapi.mjs from src/app/api/**/route.ts. Do not edit by hand. Staff, admin, cron and dev routes are not included (see docs/api-routes.md); request/response field schemas are not declared by the handlers and are left as JSON objects. Hebrew is the default locale of every message string.

bearerAuth.description: Supabase access token of the signed-in member

ServerError.description: Server error; the body never carries raw error text
